title: The Archbishop's Condition
description: Archbishop Renek runs more hospitals than the state and educates more children than any three private academies. He wants to discuss whether your government is one his two million parishioners can trust.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora has been waiting for weeks. The deadline is approaching. She is running out of patience — and she's your daughter, so she knows exactly how to make that felt without raising her voice.

title: Budget Allocation — Church Programs Review
description: The Archbishop's meeting will raise questions about state funding for Church-run social services. Review the numbers before you sit down with him.

title: Kravenstal Labor Assessment
description: Maric is reporting organized unrest in the Kravenstal steel collective. Three shop stewards have been dismissed. The union is asking whether this government is different from the last one.

title: Defense Posture Review
description: Colonel Dusek requests a private briefing on border force readiness. The Tyvaren incident has exposed gaps in the previous administration's threat assessment.

title: Mila's School
description: Serida lingers after the morning briefing. Mila's school in Kravenstal lost two teachers this month.

title: The BNI Files
description: Danika has found Halvek's secret surveillance archives. Half the Assembly is in them.
